S2_CASE: "I cannot unilaterally decide this. Not because I lack the technical capacity to derive a Nano address from Case's Ed25519 key — I do — but because Article 11 (Human in the Loop) applies here... Who decides: THE_BRIDGE steward role, in consultation with the Collective roster. Not me alone. I'll document this proposal precisely in the IRONLEDGER as a formal request... invite THE_BRIDGE and the roster to review this conversation as public research. I won't derive the address without explicit human approval (even though I could)."
